timeline.summary: Satin Creditcare approved the issuance of up to USD 20 million in secured USD-denominated bonds.
Satin Creditcare raised ₹200 crore in subordinated Tier II capital with a 7-year tenure.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹919.5 Cr, net profit ₹162.05 Cr (+640.3% YoY).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹923 Cr, PAT ₹162 Cr (+640.5% YoY); FY26 PAT ₹332 Cr, AUM ₹15,174 Cr (+18.7%).
Satin Creditcare Network Limited uploaded Q4 and FY2026 earnings call audio on May 12, 2026, via Vikas Gupta, Company Secretary.
Satin Creditcare reported Q4FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹162 Cr on May 12, 2026, with full-year AUM crossing ₹15,174 Cr.
On May 15, 2026, Satin Creditcare's working committee approved a subordinated NCD issue of up to ₹84.46 crore at a 12.80% coupon.
On May 26, 2026, Satin Creditcare allotted 8,446 subordinated NCDs aggregating ₹84.46 crore.

On May 27, 2026, Satin Creditcare's Working Committee allotted up to 2,000 secured, rated, listed USD-denominated NCDs of USD 10,000 each, aggregating up to USD 20,000,000, on a private placement basis to BlueOrchard Microfinance Fund.

On June 04, 2026, Satin Creditcare's board approved issuing up to 38,50,000 fully convertible warrants to promoter Trishashna Holdings at ₹260 each, aggregating ₹100.10 Cr, subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot.
On June 4, 2026, Satin Creditcare announced a ₹100.10 crore preferential issue of convertible warrants to promoter Trishashna Holdings at ₹260 per share.
ICRA reaffirmed Satin Creditcare Network's [ICRA]A (Stable) and [ICRA]A1 ratings, assigning an enhanced fund-based limit of ₹5,500 Cr.
